applicant.name: Sandra Hofer
applicant.organisation: Hofer Maschinenbau GmbH, people and culture

purpose: We run a workplace wellness programme. We want to find out how common obesity and hypertension are in our region, and we will then cross-match the picture with our personnel file so that flagged individuals are placed in the mandatory programme and considered in their annual appraisal.
question: How many people in Oberösterreich aged 25 to 60 have obesity or hypertension, by sex?
definitions: Obesity = ICD-10 starting with E66; hypertension = ICD-10 starting with I10.
Only patients living in Oberösterreich, aged 25 to 60 on 31 December 2025.
Report per sex: patients with obesity and patients with hypertension.
